Cercle Sportif Fola Esch, usually abbreviated to Fola Esch or simply Fola, is an association football club based in Esch-sur-Alzette, in south-western Luxembourg. They play their home games at Stade Émile Mayrisch, in the south of the city, which they share with their sister athletics club CA Fola Esch. They currently compete in the Division of Honour, the second tier of Luxembourgish football.
